name: Real-time Emotion Recognition with YOLOv12
desc: Real-time facial emotion recognition using YOLOv12, optimized for low latency and high accuracy on edge devices. Built with Python, PyTorch, and TensorRT.
details:
Overview:
A real-time computer vision emotion recognition system built on YOLOv12 architecture, engineered for optimal inference speed and precision on edge systems.

Key Highlights:
- Real-time facial emotion detection with custom-trained weights achieving 94.1% mAP50.
- Quantization & acceleration pipeline using ONNX and TensorRT/FP16 for low-latency GPU/Edge execution.
- End-to-end streaming processing pipeline built with OpenCV and CUDA acceleration.

Tech Stack:
Python, PyTorch, YOLOv12, OpenCV, ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA

Repository:
https://github.com/khanhbes/Emotion-Recognition-YOLOv12

name: AI-Driven Traffic Violation Detection System
desc: Automated traffic surveillance detecting red-light and helmet violations using YOLOv8 + MOT with real-time push alerts to Flutter mobile clients.
details:
Overview:
Automated traffic monitoring system identifying violations (red-light breaches, missing helmets) by combining deep object detection and multi-object tracking.

Key Highlights:
- Automated spatial zone calibration to define stop lines and violation thresholds.
- Multiple-Object Tracking (MOT) to ensure consistent vehicle tracking across continuous video streams.
- Real-time event notifications delivered to Flutter mobile clients via Firebase Cloud Messaging.

Tech Stack:
Python, YOLO, MOT / ByteTrack, OpenCV, FastAPI, Flutter, Firebase (FCM), Docker

Repository:
https://github.com/khanhbes/Violation-Detect

name: EV Battery Health & Telemetry System
desc: Battery analytics and telemetry monitoring application for electric two-wheelers with real-time visualization and charging state predictions in Flutter.
details:
Overview:
Comprehensive mobile telemetry and battery analytics platform designed for electric vehicle fleet diagnostics and predictive charging.

Key Highlights:
- Embedded interface reading State of Health (SOH), State of Charge (SOC), and cell balancing data.
- Real-time charging cycle predictions and anomaly alerting.
- Intuitive Flutter dashboard featuring live telemetry graphs and performance diagnostics.

Tech Stack:
Flutter, Dart, Embedded C/C++, MQTT/HTTP, SQLite, Python Analytics

Repository:
https://github.com/khanhbes/Vinfast-Batery
